The main takeaway from our work is that
the relative expression level of a Rab does not determine whether it is selectively affected in a disease of prenylation.
the prenylation status of a particular Rab protein is not necessarily a good predictor for its role in a particular disease.
Rab27a is a particularly sensitive target of the Rab geranyltransferase system, and that the selective under-prenylation of Rab proteins in these diseases is not simply the result of mass action.
